history-control=PASS
frontend-ready=PASS

cases.oracle: A trusted Python controller owns independent PTYs and records exact bytes, tty flags, screen status and the fixed child’s input. A VM-only control first verifies private-PTY raw mode and restoration.
cases.comparison: Pre-attach captured history is verified before attachment, the child emits fixed new binary bytes only after readiness, and every named outcome is asserted separately with bounded raw diagnostics. Raw initial, active and final termios fields, control characters, status and forced-cleanup state are retained per frontend.
